function.name: realtime_aqi
function.description: Weather forecast. Get real-time Air Quality Index (AQI). Provides current AQI, PM2.5, and PM10 information.

function.name: search
function.description: Search for general knowledge or personal history information.

source.description: The source of information to search from.

query_item.description: The specific item or topic to search for (e.g., 'Red delicious apple').

query.description: The specific question or property to retrieve (e.g., 'Nutritional content').

function.name: QueryStock
function.description: This API queries the stock price of a given stock code and date.

stockCode.description: The stock code of the given stock.

stockPriceDate.description: The date of the stock price.

stockPrice.description: The stock price of the given stock.

function.name: temporal_attention
function.description: Set or unset a temporal attention or reminder.

action.description: Whether to set or unset the attention.

time.description: The time duration or specific time (e.g., 'Ten minutes').

content.description: The content of the attention (e.g., 'Get ready for work').

function.name: guided_activity
function.description: Initiate a guided activity like meditation or workout.

target.description: The target device (e.g., 'smart lights in kitchen').

function.name: communication
function.description: Send a message or share content with someone.

function.name: find_directions
function.description: Find directions to a specific location.

function.name: realtime_weather
function.description: Get real-time weather information including temperature, humidity, and wind conditions.

city.description: The city for which to retrieve the weather, e.g., 'Taipei'

function.name: calendar_event
function.description: Create, modify, or query events in the personal calendar.

action.description: The action to perform on the calendar.

title.description: The title of the event (e.g., 'Team Meeting').

time.description: The time or time range for the event (e.g., 'tomorrow 2 PM' or 'this week').

function.name: recipe_search
function.description: Search for recipes based on ingredients or dish name.

query.description: Ingredients or the name of the dish (e.g., 'chicken and broccoli stir fry').

function.name: financial_query
function.description: Get real-time stock quotes or currency exchange rates.

target.description: The stock ticker symbol or currency pair (e.g., 'AAPL' or 'USD to EUR').

function.name: play_media
function.description: Play music or video content from a streaming service.

content.description: The song, artist, album, or video to play (e.g., 'Jazz playlist' or 'latest news').

function.name: book_service
function.description: Book a local service such as a table at a restaurant or a taxi.

service_type.description: The type of service to book.

details.description: Specific details for the booking (e.g., 'table for 2 at Italian restaurant tonight 7 PM').

function.name: note_taking
function.description: Quickly create or append to a personal note or list.

content.description: The content of the note (e.g., 'Grocery list: milk, eggs, bread').

function.name: travel_search
function.description: Search for flight or hotel availability.

type.description: The type of travel service to search for.

details.description: Travel details (e.g., 'flights from SFO to JFK next Friday' or 'hotels in London for 3 nights').

function.name: calculate
function.description: Perform mathematical calculations or solve equations.

expression.description: The mathematical expression or problem (e.g., '15 percent of 300' or 'sqrt(81)').

function.name: CheckBusSchedule
function.description: Check the bus schedule for a specific bus stop.

busStopName.description: The name of the bus stop.
